final: WITH s AS (SELECT si.entrystat AS entrystat, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_temp, AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_img FROM scanenvironment e JOIN sites si ON e.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, avg_temp, avg_img, avg_img - (SELECT AVG(avg_img) FROM s) AS diff_from_mean FROM s
